command:
set -e
git config user.email ci@example.com; git config user.name ci
echo "$(lsb_release -ds 2>/dev/null) | $(g++ --version | head -1)"
git fetch -q --unshallow origin || true
git remote add up https://github.com/boykopovar/AnyPS5.git
git fetch -q up main
git log --oneline -4
git diff --stat up/main...HEAD | tail -20
echo "=== conventions"; python3 tools/check_conventions.py --base up/main 2>&1 | tail -8
git submodule update --init --recursive --depth 1 -q || git submodule update --init --recursive -q
cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DBUILD_TESTING=ON -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache > /tmp/configure.log 2>&1 || { tail -60 /tmp/configure.log; exit 1; }
T="guest_libc_internal_ios_base_tests guest_libc_internal_aligned_new_tests guest_libc_internal_mtx_tests guest_init_once_tests guest_locale_tests guest_libc_threads_tests"
cmake --build build --target $T libSceLibcInternal > /tmp/build.log 2>&1 || { grep -B2 -A12 "error" /tmp/build.log | head -150; exit 1; }
echo BUILD_OK
ctest --test-dir build -R "^(guest_libc_internal_ios_base|guest_libc_internal_aligned_new|guest_libc_internal_mtx|guest_init_once|guest_locale|guest_libc_threads)$" --output-on-failure --timeout 60
cmake --build build --target libs > /tmp/libs.log 2>&1 || true
for P in $(find build -name "libSceLibcInternal*.prx"); do echo "== $P"; for n in I5jcbATyIWo X9D8WWSG3As; do echo "$n exported $(nm -D --defined-only "$P" | awk '{print $3}' | grep -cx -- "$n" || true) time(s)"; done; done
